channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 2026 USTA Alabama Junior Open (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sat 10/17 – Sun 10/18 · times not yet published | Mobile Tennis Center | No published price. A statewide junior tennis tournament brings about 200 young players to the Mobile Tennis Center for a two-day weekend. As with the facility's other USTA events this fall, the host page does not publish match times.

item.title: 36th Annual Alabama Veterans Affairs Association Conference (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sunday 10/18 | Orange Beach Convention Center | No published price. The Orange Beach Convention Center hosts the 36th Annual Alabama Veterans Affairs Association Conference from Sunday, October 18, through Thursday, October 22. The statewide conference brings training and professional development programming to Alabama Veterans Affairs Association members.

item.title: 38th Annual Jubilee Festival of Arts (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 10/18 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | W.O. Lott Park | Free. Olde Towne Daphne fills with more than one hundred local and regional artists showing handmade jewelry, paintings, pottery, sculpture, wood and mixed media work along the Eastern Shore of Mobile Bay. The festival also runs a kids art park and a food court alongside the market vendors.

item.title: Blithe Spirit: Theatre 98 (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Weekends 10/16-11/1/2026 · eves + matinees | Theatre 98, Fairhope | from $20. Noël Coward's classic ghost-comedy plays at Fairhope's intimate community playhouse, a witty, dressed-up date in Fairhope.

item.title: CCB Lobster Fest, Round 2 (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Fri 10/16 to Sun 10/18 (moved from 10/9 to 10/11 for the weather) | Coastal County Brewing Company | No published price. Coastal County Brewing Company brings Lobster Fest back for a second round from October 9 to 11. The brewery lists Friday starting at 5:00 PM and Saturday and Sunday from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. The event is at the brewery on E Olive Rd in Pensacola.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: MONOCHROME exhibition (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sunday 9/27 to Saturday 10/24 · times not posted | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Monochrome is a group show by three artists at Blue Morning Gallery, 21 S. Palafox Place in downtown Pensacola, running through Saturday, October 24. The black-and-white work asks what you notice, such as shadow angles, line curves and surface grain. The First Friday reception was October 2 and has passed.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Oct 17 to Oct 30 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions from October through April. The first sessions in this window run Saturday 10/17 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/18 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Saturday 10/24 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/25 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Friday 10/30 at 9:30 PM. Capacity is limited for each session, so buy tickets early.

item.title: Pumpkin Decorating Contest at Niceville Library (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Entries through Saturday 10/17 · voting Monday 10/19 to Saturday 10/24 · winners Tuesday 10/27 | Niceville Library | No published price. Niceville Library runs a pumpkin decorating contest for ages 13 and older. Entrants drop off a decorated pumpkin with a completed entry form during library hours through Saturday, October 17, and visitors vote for a favorite from October 19 to 24. The top three pumpkins win prizes announced on October 27, and entrants collect their pumpkins by 2:00 PM on October 31.

item.title: Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Fridays 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM · Saturdays 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM · Sundays 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM through 11/1 | Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction | from $25. Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction runs an indoor haunted house at 811 St Francis St in downtown Mobile on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights through Sunday, November 1. Guests walk through dark mazes with live scare actors, and optional Blackout and Chamber mini escape games cost extra. The attraction warns it may be too intense for younger children, and every child must be accompanied by an adult.

item.title: The 39 Steps: Hitchcock Farce (ECTC) (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Oct 15-25 · Thu-Sat 7 PM · Sun 2 PM · Wed 1 PM · Thu 10/22 also 1 PM | Emerald Coast Theatre Company | No published price. Four actors play 150 roles in a full-tilt Hitchcock spoof that is clean, fast, and laugh-out-loud. It is the safe-bet theatre date of the fall.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Emerald Coast Fall Classic Beach Volleyball (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Wednesday 10/14 to Sunday 10/18 · 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM daily | The Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island | No published price. Beach volleyball teams play doubles and the Fudpucker four-player tournament on the sand at the Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island. Play runs 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM each day. The Men and Women pool play is Saturday, and playoffs and finals are Sunday, with the Women's Open final around 3:00 PM and a costume contest at 3:45 PM. The schedule is tentative, so check the tournament page before driving.

item.title: Fall Into Family History at Santa Rosa County Libraries (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 Pace · Wednesday 10/14 Jay · Wednesday 10/21 Gulf Breeze · Wednesday 10/28 Navarre · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM | Santa Rosa County libraries: Pace, Jay, Gulf Breeze and Navarre | No published price. The library system's lead reference specialist visits one branch each Wednesday in October to help people start or extend a family tree. Visitors can bring a specific research question or simply stop by to learn how to get started with the library's genealogy resources. The help runs during regular library hours, so no appointment time is listed.

item.title: Riptide Cardcon (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sunday 10/18 · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM | Destin-Fort Walton Beach Rigdon Center | Free. Riptide Cardcon bills itself as the Emerald Coast's premier card show, and admission is free. More than 210 vendor tables fill about 22,000 square feet of the Rigdon Center with Pokémon and other trading card games, One Piece, sports cards and memorabilia, from 9 AM to 6 PM. JSA is on site to authenticate cards and take submissions, and food trucks stay all day.

item.title: 55th Annual Little Sisters of the Poor Lawn Party (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sunday 10/18 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Sacred Heart Residence | No published price. The Little Sisters of the Poor hold their 55th annual Lawn Party on Sunday, October 18 from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM on the grounds of the Sacred Heart Residence in midtown Mobile. The family friendly fundraiser has a petting zoo, games, raffles, concessions, a bake sale, a plant sale and live music.

item.title: Coco & Crawlers (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Thursday 9/17 · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library, Youth Programming Room | No published price. This caregiver meetup in the Youth Programming Room at Ben May Main Library pairs children's play with a warm drink. It gives caregivers time to connect with each other. It runs Thursday morning from 10 AM to 11 AM, repeating on the third Thursday of the month, with more dates on October 15, November 19 and December 17. Registration is requested but not required.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Daily Public Weigh-Ins (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Daily, Oct 1 – Oct 31 · 10:00 AM-7:00 PM | Docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar | Free. Anglers competing in the month-long Destin Fishing Rodeo bring their catches to the scale on the harbor docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar every day in October. The public is welcome to watch for free from 10 AM to 7 PM, and the crowd tends to grow with the size of the fish coming off the boats.

item.title: Fall Pop-Up Farmers Market at Orange Beach Waterfront Park (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sunday 10/18 · 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM | Orange Beach Waterfront Park | No published price. Orange Beach Parks and Recreation holds a fall edition of its Pop-Up Farmers Market at Waterfront Park on Canal Road. The city promises fresh produce and a curated group of local vendors. It runs for four hours on a Sunday, which makes it an easy stop on a beach weekend.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free.

item.title: DiscipleStory (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sundays 9/13 – 10/18 (of an 8-week class) · 11:00 AM (end time not published) | Crosspoint Niceville Campus, Room 912 | No published price. An eight-week Sunday morning class at Crosspoint's Niceville campus walks participants through identifying their own story, passions, abilities and role in the church's mission. The class starts September 13 at 11 AM; the campus newsletter does not publish an end time.

item.title: Midday Melodies: Downtown Foley (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 · 11:00 AM | Heritage Park | No published price. Foley Main Street schedules a lunchtime concert at Heritage Park on Wednesdays in October, starting October 7 at 11:00 AM. The 2026 lineup is the Wiley Pete Duo on October 7, Dan Lee on October 14, This Side of 49 on October 21, and Tennessee Tim and Doug Drake on October 28. The 2025 series invited guests to bring a picnic blanket or lawn chair and pick up lunch from a nearby downtown restaurant.

item.title: STEAM: Midnight Kitty Painting (Pensacola Library) (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 to Saturday 10/31 · 11:00 AM | Pensacola Library | No published price. STEAM: Midnight Kitty Painting is a step-by-step painting class at Pensacola Library, 239 N. Spring St., where you paint a little shadow kitty watching the moon. It is recommended for ages 10 and up. A themed painting class is held almost every Saturday through Oct 31 at 11 AM.

item.title: Sunday Brunch with John Wheeler: Seville Quarter (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sundays · 11:00 AM-2:00 PM | Seville Quarter, Apple Annie's | No published price. Brunch runs in the courtyard room while John Wheeler plays through it. It is a daytime date that ends early enough to still leave a Sunday afterward.

item.title: Mobile Latin Fest (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sunday 10/18 · 12:00 PM to 7:00 PM (moved from Sat 10/10) | Mardi Gras Park | Free. Mardi Gras Park hosts Mobile Latin Fest on Sunday, October 18, from noon to 7 PM, moved from October 10 because of Isaias. It is a family-friendly celebration of Latin American and Caribbean culture. The Hispanic American Business Association organizes the festival, which brings together music, dance, food and art for the day. Admission is free.

item.title: Brunch & Rally (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sundays · 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM | Pickleball at OWA | from $10. Pickleball at OWA runs indoor open play every Sunday afternoon, paired with a discount for anyone who shows a same-day receipt from Waffles R Wild. Open play costs $10 for nonmembers, members play free, and a Waffles R Wild receipt brings the nonmember rate down to $7. It repeats weekly, so today's session is one stop on an ongoing schedule.

item.title: Pokémon League at Trinity Games (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sundays · 1 PM-4 PM | Trinity Games | Free. Pokémon League at Trinity Games is a free weekly play session every Sunday from 1-4 PM at the shop in Pensacola. Trinity Games is a Wizards-certified Magic and trading card store with open play tables. The shop also runs other Pokémon events.

item.title: UWF Women's Volleyball vs Lipscomb: Volley Back to the 70s (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sunday 10/18 · 1:00 PM | UWF Field House, Building 54 | from $3. UWF women's volleyball hosts Lipscomb at the UWF Field House for Volley Back to the 70s. General admission is $5, with a $3 rate for seniors, military and visiting students. UWF students, faculty and staff and children under 6 get in free.

item.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Weekly Casual Play and Tournament (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sundays · 1 PM | GameMasters Guild | from $5. The Yu-Gi-Oh weekly tournament is an Advanced Constructed Yu-Gi-Oh TCG event at GameMasters Guild in Crestview, every Sunday at 1 PM. Entry is $5 including tax. Every player gets an OTS pack, and top placers get more.

item.title: Destin Commons Market (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Saturdays 10/17, 11/21 and 12/5 · 2 PM-6 PM | The Lawn at South Street, Destin Commons | No published price. The Destin Commons Market is a monthly market on The Lawn at South Street at Destin Commons. Local farmers, artisans, small businesses and specialty vendors sell handcrafted goods, baked items, artwork, jewelry and wellness products. It runs 2-6 PM on October 17, November 21 and December 5, and the December date adds kids' crafts.

item.title: Pours & Encores (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sun 10/18 · 2:00 PM | Perfect Plain Brewing Company | Free. Pensacola Opera takes its free community event series to Perfect Plain Brewing Company for an afternoon program pairing opera with the brewery's taproom setting. It is held inside a working taproom rather than a concert hall.

item.title: Flora-Bama Oktoberfest (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sunday 10/18 · 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM | Flora-Bama | Free. Flora-Bama throws a family-friendly Oktoberfest each October with a stein-hoisting contest, German food while supplies last, and live polka music from The Brats. There is no cover charge, children are welcome, and the free drink perk is limited to guests 21 and older. Stein registration opens at 2:00 PM, the contest begins at 3:00 PM, with food and music following at 4:00 PM.

item.title: Kamerman Piano Series: Zehao Bai (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sunday 10/18 · 3:00 PM | Rolfs Music Hall, UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82 | No published price. Pianist Zehao Bai plays the Kamerman Piano Series at Rolfs Music Hall on the UWF campus. He is a soloist, collaborator and educator who performed and taught in the United States, Europe and Asia in 2025.

item.title: Make & Take Art: weekly drop-in art sessions (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Thursdays 8/27 through 12/3 · 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM | Mobile Museum of Art | Free. The museum runs a free Thursday afternoon art session most weeks, working through materials and techniques borrowed from artists on view. Projects range from geometric shape painting to a Basquiat-inspired dinosaur build. The printed schedule also lists a session for September 8, but that date falls on a Tuesday, not a Thursday, so check with the museum first.

item.title: Paint Your Pet at Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach (all ages) (SUN 10/18)
item.description: Sunday 10/18 · 3:00 PM | Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach | from $57. Paint Your Pet is an all-ages session at Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach, 255 Miracle Strip Pkwy SE, Suite B-8. It runs 3-5 PM on Sunday, Oct 18, and costs $57-$59.
